sql: SELECT CAST(t1.learner_tally * t1.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL) / 100, t2.points FROM college_annual AS t1 INNER JOIN college_score_annual AS t2 ON t1.college_identifier = t2.college_identifier WHERE t2.annual = 2015 AND t1.college_identifier = 100

SELECT DISTINCT t1.nation_label FROM nation AS t1 INNER JOIN college AS t2 ON t1.identifier = t2.nation_identifier INNER JOIN college_annual AS t3 ON t2.identifier = t3.college_identifier WHERE t3.annual = 2013 AND t3.learner_tally * 100 > (SELECT AVG(learner_tally) FROM college_annual) * 98
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM college_annual AS t1 INNER JOIN college_score_annual AS t2 ON t1.college_identifier = t2.college_identifier WHERE t2.points = 90 AND t1.annual = 2011

SELECT SUM(t1.learner_tally) - SUM(CAST(t1.learner_tally * t1.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL) / 100) FROM college_annual AS t1 INNER JOIN college AS t2 ON t1.college_identifier = t2.identifier WHERE t2.college_label = 'Harvard University' AND t1.annual BETWEEN 2011 AND 2012

SELECT CAST(t1.learner_tally * t1.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL) / 100 FROM college_annual AS t1 INNER JOIN college AS t2 ON t1.college_identifier = t2.identifier WHERE t2.college_label = 'Harvard University' AND t1.annual = 2012

SELECT CAST(t1.learner_tally * t1.percent_woman_learners AS REAL) / 100 FROM college_annual AS t1 INNER JOIN college AS t2 ON t1.college_identifier = t2.identifier WHERE t1.annual = 2011 AND t2.college_label = 'Stanford University'

SELECT t1.learner_tally - CAST(t1.learner_tally * t1.percent_woman_learners AS REAL) / 100 FROM college_annual AS t1 INNER JOIN college AS t2 ON t1.college_identifier = t2.identifier WHERE t2.college_label = 'Emory University' AND t1.annual = 2011

SELECT t1.nation_label, CAST(t3.learner_tally * t3.percent_woman_learners AS REAL) / 100 FROM nation AS t1 INNER JOIN college AS t2 ON t1.identifier = t2.nation_identifier INNER JOIN college_annual AS t3 ON t2.identifier = t3.college_identifier WHERE t3.annual = 2011 AND t3.college_identifier = 23

SELECT DISTINCT t1.college_label FROM college AS t1 INNER JOIN college_score_annual AS t2 ON t1.identifier = t2.college_identifier WHERE t2.annual = 2015 AND t2.points * 100 < (SELECT AVG(points) FROM college_score_annual WHERE annual = 2015) * 28
